text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both up solidly over the past day, with BTC holding its dominance above 59% while the broader altcoin complex keeps pace, signaling synchronized strength across major assets. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 65 despite a slight weekly decline, suggesting cautious optimism rather than euphoria. Volume remains substantial at $100B, supporting the moves but not at extreme levels that would indicate panic buying or capitulation.
